title: Staggered Activation Lattice for Private Instances — Quarterly Sprint Strategy
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Objective: Define a quarterly roadmap plan and sprint cadence (the 'activation lattice') for Private/VPC/on-prem enterprise features that enables staggered customer activations, minimizes upgrade blast radius, and maps directly to OKRs for adoption and reliability. Background: As more enterprise customers request private instances with stricter upgrade windows and compliance requirements, we need a predictable tranche-based activation plan that aligns product milestones, infra readiness, and sales onboarding. This ticket captures the PM plan, acceptance criteria, milestone schedule, rollout cohort design, and operational handoffs.
acceptance_criteria: Quarterly sprint plan with slot-based activation windows published and reviewed by Eng/Design/Sales/Support
OKRs mapped to each activation tranche with measurable signals (uptime, latency P95, rollout lead time)
Compatibility checklist and automated preflight tests defined for each release lane
Runbook for rollbacks and carve-outs drafted and validated in a dry run with one internal partner
milestones: Milestone 1 — Sprint 1: Define tranche boundaries, cohort sizing rules and customer selection criteria (by 2026-01-20)
Milestone 2 — Sprint 2: Finalize API/console gating features and opt-in flags; create preflight test suites (by 2026-02-10)
Milestone 3 — Sprint 3: Internal dry-run with staging tenant and observability dashboards (by 2026-03-05)
Milestone 4 — Sprint 4: First public tranche activation + post-activation retros (by 2026-04-15)
Milestone 5 — Sprint 5: OKR assessment and cadence iteration for next quarter (by 2026-04-30)
tasks: Coordinate customer cohort nominations with AE and Solutions Engineering
Bake gating flags into Private control plane and document feature flags in Console
Work with Eng to create automated compatibility preflight runbook
Add rollout telemetry to Console: per-tenant health, latency P95, token cost delta
Produce a one-pager for Sales and Customer Success that describes tranche expectations and rollback policy
rollout_plan: We will adopt a 5-lane staggered activation lattice. Each lane corresponds to a customer cohort (pilot, early adopters, controlled cohort, general availability, extended customers). Tranches unlock sequentially after success criteria are met (no more than 2 Sev2s, latency regressions <10% P95, KV cache hit rate not decreased by more than 5%). Each tranche activation has a 72-hour monitoring window and an automated canary rollback trigger. Post-tranche retro and decision gates determine next tranche unlock.
risks: Integration regressions in customer-managed networking causing longer remediation windows
Insufficient telemetry granularity leading to delayed detection of regressions
Customer dissatisfaction if tranche assignment and communication are misaligned
Security signoffs delaying tranche releases beyond planned windows
